Description: The Queue is a reactive queue that a host component creates for itself and keeps in a private field. It holds items with an id and a priority, hands them out in order, keeps them in IndexedDB so they survive a reload, and dispatches an event for every change. The `storage` option names the IndexedDB database that keeps the queue: `new Queue({ order, storage })` restores the items it held before, and keeps the database in step behind every change, while every operation acts in memory at once. Without `storage`, the queue lives in memory only. It is an EventTarget-based add-on rather than a custom element: it declares no Tag, Composition or Gestures. An item is the host's own object, `{ id, priority } & T`: the queue owns `id` and `priority`, and keeps every other field as the host gave it.

waiting.description: The items that wait to be handed out, as a list of `Item`, in the order `take()` hands them out: the order they were added, or, in a priority queue, the highest `priority` first and the earliest added first among equals. An item that is put back or changed keeps the place its first addition gave it. Each item is the stored, frozen copy. Restored items keep the place they had, and come before the items added since the queue was created.

working.description: The items that have been taken and are being worked on, as a list of `Item`, in the order they were taken. An item stays here until it is removed or put back. Each item is the stored, frozen copy. Restored items that were being worked on come back here, as they were: the host decides whether to put them back.

order.description: The order in which the queue hands out its waiting items: `fifo`, first in, first out; or `priority`, the highest priority first and the earliest added first among equals. Chosen once, by the `order` field of the options given to the constructor, `new Queue({ order })`; the options are read at construction and not kept. Options that are not an object throw `Invalid options value: <value>`, an `order` that is not on its list throws `Invalid options value: order is invalid`, and fields the queue does not read are ignored. Without options, or without `order`, the queue is `fifo`.

condition.description: The condition of the queue as a whole, computed from its items: `empty` when it holds none, `waiting` while any item waits, and `busy` while items are being worked on and none waits.

add.description: Puts an item at its place among the waiting items. Its `priority` is 1 when it has none. Throws `Invalid item value: <value>` for a value that is not an object, `Invalid item value: id is required` or `id is invalid` for an id that is absent or not a non-empty string, `Invalid item value: priority is invalid` for a priority that is not a whole number from 1 to 10, and `Invalid item value: id is already in the queue` for an id the queue holds, waiting or being worked on.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The item to add: the host's object with an `id` that is unique in the queue, an optional `priority` from 1 (lowest) to 10 (highest), and any other fields of the host's own.

take.description: Hands out the next waiting item and moves it to the items being worked on, so that it is never handed out twice. Returns `null`, and changes nothing, when no item waits.

peek.description: Returns the item `take()` would hand out, without taking it, or `null` when no item waits. Changes nothing.

update.description: Changes the item with the given `id`: the given fields replace the item's own, and every other field is kept. The item keeps its place, or, in a priority queue whose item changes priority, takes the place its new priority gives it; it stays waiting or being worked on. Throws as `add` does for an invalid item, except that `priority` keeps the item's own when absent. An id the queue does not hold changes nothing.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The `id` of the item to change, and the fields to change.

remove.description: Removes the item with the given id, waiting or being worked on. Throws `Invalid id value: <value>` for an id that is not a non-empty string. An id the queue does not hold changes nothing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the item to remove.

putBack.description: Puts an item that is being worked on back among the waiting items, at the place it would have had had it never been taken. Throws `Invalid id value: <value>` for an id that is not a non-empty string. An id that is waiting, or that the queue does not hold, changes nothing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the item to put back.

onadd.description: Dispatched when an item is added.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the item as the queue holds it.

ontake.description: Dispatched when an item is taken and is being worked on.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the item as the queue holds it.

onupdate.description: Dispatched when an item is changed.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the changed item as the queue holds it.

onremove.description: Dispatched when an item is removed.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the item as the queue held it.

onputback.description: Dispatched when an item that was being worked on is put back among the waiting items.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the item as the queue holds it.

onempty.description: Dispatched when `condition` changes to `empty`, after the event for the item that emptied the queue.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new condition of the queue.

onwaiting.description: Dispatched when `condition` changes to `waiting`, after the event for the item that made an item wait.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new condition of the queue.

onbusy.description: Dispatched when `condition` changes to `busy`, after the event for the item that left only items being worked on.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new condition of the queue.
